test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

She is a very __creative __artist and one can see that in her paintings.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Innovative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"creative"** means having the quality or power of creating, resulting from originality of thought or expression. (रचनात्मक)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a creative mind that always comes up with unique ideas.
 
 

 
• **"Innovative"** refers to introducing new ideas, methods, or products; it is synonymous with being inventive and original. (नवीन)
 
 
• **Example: **The company's innovative technology has revolutionized the industry.
